policy_rules: Consultancy, medicines, and medical tests are covered for Allopathy, Homeopathy, Physiotherapy, and Ayurvedic (AYUSH) treatments.
Vision-related expenses (spectacles/lenses) capped at INR 10,000 per employee/dependent per policy year.
Pre-natal outpatient care capped at INR 19,900 per instance.
Pre-natal benefit limited to a maximum of 2 instances of childbirth.
Submission of an EDD (Expected Date of Delivery) certificate is mandatory to unlock pre-natal benefits.
Pre-natal outpatient care limited to a maximum of 10 visits.
Fetal ultrasounds limited to a maximum of 5 total across all trimesters.
Dental coverage is restricted to non-cosmetic treatments such as dentures, cavity fillings, or non-gold metal caps.
Cancer screening frequency: Cervical (once a year), Breast (once in 2 years), Colorectal (once in 3 years).
Vaccination expenses can only be claimed under the specific vaccination benefit and not under other benefit heads.
Medical treatments conducted at home (e.g., peritoneal dialysis) are excluded.
Cosmetic treatments, weight management, and peeling procedures are excluded.
Consultations with nutritionists and dieticians are excluded, even if prescribed.
Infertility treatment or management is excluded.
Services must be availed within the policy period: 01 April 2026 to 31 March 2027.
